method: Read native images and facade-ground edge candidates; never warp image pixels. Camera inference assumes a rectangular footprint.

firstPass.reason: Facade-ground edge slopes on several first-pass sprites imply a much shallower camera than the existing nominal 30-degree map; prompts alone do not prove perspective.

correctedCandidate.observation: Higher oblique redraw; both visible ground edges now close to nominal 30-degree directions. Exact corner and hidden-geometry measurements remain candidates.
